requirements.TITLE: Core mechanism / configuration baseline
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: authoritative assembly hierarchy; exact part/body identity; configuration/revision manifest
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: authoritative component mapping; independent configuration verification

requirements.TITLE: Bilateral longitudinal load paths
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: exact rail geometry/sections; rail axes/datums; mounting interfaces; parallelism/spacing; runner/capture geometry; continuous load path
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: authoritative rail geometry/tolerances; hardpoint/fixture mapping; measured L/R reactions

requirements.TITLE: Controlled carriage translation
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: carriage identity; prismatic joint; rail/runner mating; travel/end-stops; constraint graph
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: authoritative joint semantics; released end-stop geometry; executable authoritative kinematic proof

requirements.TITLE: Ride-down energy-management path
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: absorber mount geometry; working axis; clevis/pin interfaces; stroke envelope; bilateral topology; replaceability
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: selected/serialized absorber; measured F-x/F-v/hysteresis/temperature; exact mount tolerances

requirements.TITLE: Ride-down dynamic response / bilateral reactions
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: displacement datum; L/R reaction locations; absorber force/stroke interface; instrumentation clearance
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: calibrated sensors; actual load case; raw measured x(t), F_L, F_R

requirements.TITLE: Pelvic-control / anti-submarining geometry
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: seat-pan/pelvic geometry; reference surfaces/datums; front control/ramp; attachment/load path
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: released detailed geometry; dynamic pelvis/belt/ATD evidence; occupant qualification

requirements.TITLE: Left rotation-control path
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: link geometry; pivot axes; attachment topology; stops/limits; clearance; inspection datums
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: authoritative dimensions/tolerances; joint compliance; link-load evidence; axis verification

requirements.TITLE: Right rotation-control path
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: right-side link geometry; pivot axis; attachment topology; symmetry/inspection
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: authoritative dimensions/tolerances; joint compliance; axis verification; L/R differential evidence

requirements.TITLE: Seatback frame
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: frame geometry; hinge interface; link mounts; section/thickness; material identity; weld/joint definition
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: released fabrication geometry; material certificates; weld/joint spec; structural capacity evidence

requirements.TITLE: Multi-state lock / event transition
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: capture geometry; lock mechanism; engagement interface; release/reset; fault containment; state sensing
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: final physical implementation; fault/unintended-release tests; validated trigger/timing

requirements.TITLE: Rebound control
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: working axis; mounting/capture geometry; reverse-motion interface; reset path; clearance
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: final mechanism selection; measured force/velocity law; rebound/secondary-excursion evidence

requirements.TITLE: Occupant-restraint path availability
requirements.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: anchor geometry; structural load path; belt/airbag interface; vehicle hardpoints
requirements.MISSING_EVIDENCE: vehicle-specific anchor coordinates; dynamic belt geometry/anchorage loads; sled/ATD evidence

rade_pass_forbidden_conditions: PASS on H/R-point dependency without authoritative vehicle/package reference and traceable coordinates.
PASS on occupant packaging without vehicle-specific envelope, seating reference and clearance verification.
PASS on backrest angle/motion or end-stops that treats model reference motion as physical capability.
PASS on clearance/interference without adequate intended-contact classification plus authoritative geometry/motion verification.
PASS on rail/hardpoint integration without controlled vehicle mounting geometry and relevant interface evidence.
PASS on BIW interface logic without controlled vehicle structural interface evidence.
PASS on kinematic conflicts without authoritative joint semantics, end-stops and motion verification.
PASS on packaging feasibility from visual fit alone.
PASS on DFM/DFA or manufacturing readiness without released drawings/PMI/GD&T, process and inspection evidence.
PASS on materials, fasteners, tolerances, joint compliance, absorber, lock, rebound or physical behavior where required evidence is missing.
PASS on CAE validation while critical inputs remain unresolved or solver/model execution evidence is absent.
PASS on crash/occupant safety, injury reduction, regulatory compliance, OEM approval or manufacturing readiness without their corresponding evidence gates.
Any overall PASS that suppresses a known blocker or converts an assumption/reference/target into a confirmed fact.
